title: RFdiffusion designs epitope-specific VHHs, scFvs and antibodies de novo
summary: Cryo-EM structures confirmed binding pose of designed VHHs against influenza haemagglutinin and C. difficile TcdB; initial designs had tens to hundreds of nanomolar Kd, improved by affinity maturation. Therapeutic benefit not shown. Cryo-EM confirms pose for two VHH designs; scFv/full-antibody and other epitopes characterized less deeply.
ai_technology: Fine-tuned RFdiffusion (RFdiffusion2-based) network plus yeast display
organization: University of Washington Institute for Protein Design

source_review.scope: Abstract and metadata via Europe PMC; full text not read
